item.title: REBUILDING TRUST: General Yawd Serk’s Framework for National Reconciliation
item.description: On the occasion of 79th Shan National Day, General Yawd Serk made known his vision of on how to restart reconciliation process to end the ongoing civil war, which seems to be no end in sight. In the meantime, prior to the 7th February 2026, Shan National Day, a four-day consultation meeting was held among […] The post REBUILDING TRUST: General Yawd Serk’s Framework for National Reconciliation appeared first on Shan Herald Agency for News.
